Reusable parameter annotations may vary as required by the checker. Valid dimensions are 0..32 inclusive; cells contains exactly width*height binary values in row-major order. import Base

# B3/S23 asks for three in either view: the ring, or the ring plus its center.
def Life.three(cell: U32, +ring: U32) -> U32:
  Bool.to_u32(
    Bool.or(
      U32.is_eq(ring, 3),
      U32.is_eq((ring + cell : U32), 3)))

# Cut the flat board into rows and cap every row with dead cells.
def Life.halo(
  height: Nat,
  +width: Nat,
  +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      (0 <> List.append(
        &2,
        U32,
        List.take(&2, U32, cells, width),
        [0])) <>
        Life.halo(
          rest,
          width,
          List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

# A width-counted focus slides one three-by-three window across three haloed rows.
def Life.focus(
  width: Nat,
  +north: List<&2, U32>,
  +middle: List<&2, U32>,
  +south: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match width:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      +ring = (
        Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, north, 0n), 0)
        + Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, north, 1n), 0)
        + Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, north, 2n), 0)
        + Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, middle, 0n), 0)
        + Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, middle, 2n), 0)
        + Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, south, 0n), 0)
        + Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, south, 1n), 0)
        + Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.get(&2, U32, south, 2n), 0) : U32)
      cell = Maybe.default(
        &2,
        U32,
        List.get(&2, U32, middle, 1n),
        0)
      Life.three(cell, ring) <>
        Life.focus(
          rest,
          List.tail(&2, U32, north),
          List.tail(&2, U32, middle),
          List.tail(&2, U32, south))

# A height-counted sweep applies the same three-row focus down the haloed board.
def Life.sweep(
  height: Nat,
  +width: Nat,
  +rows: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      +tail = List.tail(&2, List<&2, U32>, rows)
      north = Maybe.default(
        &2,
        List<&2, U32>,
        List.head(&2, List<&2, U32>, rows),
        Nil{})
      middle = Maybe.default(
        &2,
        List<&2, U32>,
        List.head(&2, List<&2, U32>, tail),
        Nil{})
      south = Maybe.default(
        &2,
        List<&2, U32>,
        List.head(
          &2,
          List<&2, U32>,
          List.tail(&2, List<&2, U32>, tail)),
        Nil{})
      List.append(
        &2,
        U32,
        Life.focus(width, north, middle, south),
        Life.sweep(rest, width, tail))

def step(
  width: U32,
  height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +w = U32.to_nat(width)
  +h = U32.to_nat(height)
  +dead = List.replicate(U32, Nat.add(w, 2n), 0)
  Life.sweep(
    h,
    w,
    dead <>
      List.append(
        &2,
        List<&2, U32>,
        Life.halo(h, w, cells),
        [dead]))

def evolve(
  turns: Nat,
  +width: U32,
  +height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
